How to Use
Plug the hair dryer into a suitable power outlet
Select the desired hot or cool air setting
Choose the preferred speed using the speed control
Direct the airflow toward the hair while maintaining a suitable distance
Use the concentrator nozzle for more focused airflow when styling
Switch off and unplug the appliance after use

Safety Information
Keep the hair dryer away from water and moisture
Do not use the appliance with wet hands
Do not block the air inlet or outlet during operation
Avoid directing excessive heat continuously at one area of the hair
Unplug the appliance after use
Allow the hair dryer to cool before storing
Stop using the appliance if it shows signs of damage or abnormal operation
